model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the "effect" of various multilingual language models—specifically mBERT-L₂, XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, XLM-R₂, mBERT-B₂, and XLM-B₂—across different language families, including IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The horizontal axis lists these language families in a left-to-right order, while the vertical axis represents the "effect" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language family has a grouped set of six bars, each corresponding to one of the models, color-coded as per the legend: light blue for mBERT-L₂, dark blue for XLM-L₂, light green for mBERT-R₂, dark green for XLM-R₂, light red for mBERT-B₂, and dark red for XLM-B₂. Error bars are included for each bar, indicating variability or confidence intervals. The heights of the bars vary significantly across both language families and models. For example, in the IE-Indic family, mBERT-R₂ (light green) reaches approximately 20, XLM-R₂ (dark green) is around 18, and mBERT-B₂ (light red) and XLM-B₂ (dark red) are both near 23–25. In contrast, for the Uralic family, all bars are near 0, with minimal effect. The Semitic family shows a notable effect for XLM-L₂ (dark blue, ~16) and XLM-B₂ (dark red, ~20), while mBERT-R₂ (light green) is negative (~-2). The chart does not sort the language families by effect magnitude, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond the standard error bars and color coding.
